info.name: KairoX · Intelligence
info.description:
The factory chatbot. A question in plain English comes back as an answer PLUS the structured data behind it, because the arithmetic is done by tools against SQL and never by a language model. Runs with no model configured and no API key at all; setting CHAT_MODEL swaps in a LangGraph ReAct agent that routes and phrases, and still never computes.

SETUP
  1. Import the whole folder and SELECT the KairoX environment
     (top-right). That is what shares one token across every
     collection — a collection variable is visible only to the
     collection that set it.
  2. Run `user` → Login. Its test script stores `access_token` for
     you; there is nothing to copy and paste.
  3. Every request here inherits bearer auth from that token.

`base_url` defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8000.

Optional query params are present but DISABLED, so each request runs
as-is. File uploads are real form-data rows — click Select Files on
the `file` row. Generated from the app's own OpenAPI schema by
`python scripts/make_postman_per_service.py` — re-run it after changing
routes rather than editing requests by hand.
